title: FFmpeg vibrance: intensity × alternate interaction experiment brief
purpose: A reusable test package that isolates the most discriminating variable pair in the FFmpeg vibrance filter — negative intensity with and without alternate=1 — to establish whether the filter produces a gray-ward fade or a hue shift. Designed so any practitioner can run it and report falsifiable observations.
